rows.label: tlk70000022_04_msg0001
rows.name:
We've finally finished choosing
additional homes and land where more
shelters can be built.

rows.label: tlk70000022_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Now we just need to raise the
funds for them. Morumo should have
it well in hand, or so I hear.

rows.label: tlk70000022_04_msg0003
rows.name:
I thought merchants cared about
nothing but profit. I suppose that
isn't always true.

rows.label: tlk70000022_04_msg0004
rows.name:
This job may turn out to be a much
bigger turning point for me than I
expected.

rows.label: tlk70000022_04_msg0005
rows.name:
...The knighting ceremony? I remember
hearing about that. What of it?
